description: Silences a signal while it stays within a set voltage of zero and passes what rises beyond it

params.text: Sets the voltage either side of zero that is silenced, from 0 to 5V; at 0 the signal passes through untouched
Scales what the CV jack adds to the width, reaching a volt of width per volt at its maximum
Subtracts that fraction of the width from whatever passes: at 1 the output leaves silence smoothly, at 0 it jumps straight to the width
Scales what the CV jack takes off the gap, reaching a fifth of the gap range per volt at its maximum

inputs.text: The signal to be silenced near zero
Adds to the width, scaled by its attenuator, with the total clamped between 0 and 5V
Moves the gap, scaled by its attenuator, with the total clamped between 0 and 1; a positive voltage reduces the gap

outputs.text: The input with the band around zero removed

notes: the GAP knob runs backwards: fully anticlockwise is 1 and fully clockwise is 0, and it starts fully anticlockwise.
the signal is processed at twice the sample rate and filtered back down, which keeps the corners of the deadband from folding back as aliasing.
the maker left the input and the output jack unnamed, so hovering them shows no tooltip text.

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
